facts.fact: ADI reports the World Bank-financed Djibouti Fondation Numerique project run by the communications ministry (MCPT) has connected nearly 100 public sites across Djibouti-ville and the interior sub-regions, including five schools outside the capital.

DJI.note: Seven schools connected under a World Bank project is a connectivity programme, not the UNESCO share of secondary schools with internet, and no compulsory curriculum is stated.
